run_continuation_evaluation: run the continuation metric evaluation for a PG-SSL model on a validation dataset
run_teacher_force_evaluation: run the teacher_force_everything metric evaluation computing token, duration, and F0 losses
run_correlation_evaluation: run the correlation metric evaluation computing duration and F0 Pearson correlations
run_cli_evaluation: run the CLI evaluation tool with --metric continuation and --path to a model checkpoint
compute_bleu_score: compute the BLEU-3 score between produced tokens and target tokens using sentence_bleu
